narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -3.22 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.005223-0.005257 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 0.005319; the first objective pays 2.11R at 0.005181.

plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.005319 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
